uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the full shipment. The centre starts with 40 units, collects 12 units/hour for 8 hours on Monday (96 units) and 7 hours on Tuesday (84 units) before 4:00 PM dispatch, totaling 220 units, which is enough. However, any unstated usage or losses could reduce stock.

Whether the centre's stock at 4:00 PM Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections, minus Tuesday shipment) is at least 150 units. After Tuesday dispatch, stock is 220-150=70 units. Wednesday collection (8 hours) adds 96 units, Thursday collection before 4:00 PM (7 hours) adds 84 units, totaling 250 units, enough. Again, unstated usage could change this.
Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon. Dispatched at 4:00 PM Tuesday, takes 3 hours, arrives by 7:00 PM Tuesday, well before deadline.
Whether the Thursday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon. Dispatched at 4:00 PM Thursday, takes 3 hours, arrives by 7:00 PM Thursday, well before deadline.

The exact number of units the hospital holds at Friday noon, considering initial stock (15 units) plus two shipments of 150 units each (total 315 units), assuming no consumption or losses. Consumption is not mentioned, so it is uncertain whether any units are used before the deadline.
